## Repository Setup Rules

- Read root `AGENTS.md` and any service `AGENTS.md` before repo work.
- For any fresh worktree work in `services/axios-cms/`, run `npm ci` in `lib/typescript/` before `npm ci`, build, lint, or test in `services/axios-cms/`. axios-cms imports symlinked shared packages whose dependencies resolve from `lib/typescript/node_modules`.
